d: Senegal beat Morocco 1-0 in the AFCON final in Rabat, celebrated their Africa Cup of Nations triumph and brought the trophy home. But months later, the title was taken away after the CAF Appeal Board ruled that Senegal had forfeited the match, awarding Morocco a 3-0 victory. Now, the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) is set to decide the fate of the AFCON 2025 title. Can Senegal overturn CAF's decision, or will Morocco be declared champions? Rupha Ramani looks at the controversy, the legal battle and what the CAS verdict means for both nations.
